thread:
sam (eng-release-manager): Heads up — final draft of the release notes and the internal announcement are ready for review. Target deploy window: tomorrow 09:00 PDT (change window 09:00–10:30). Need content sign-off + who will post the internal Slack blast. Please review by EOD today.

sam (eng-release-manager): Draft release notes below: 
```
Release v2.3.1 (2026-04-05)
- Performance: improved KV-cache warmup for long-context jobs, ~12% P50 throughput improvement.
- Telemetry: added token-level latency breakdown in Console and an API for sampling traces.
- API: new `pin_model_version` parameter for the /deploy endpoint (opt-in).
- Fixes: resolved intermittent OOM during regen on large sequences; improved error messages for model load failures.
```

maria (product): Looks good. Can we soften the API line: make it clear it's opt-in and experimental? People panic about breaking changes. :sweat_smile:

alex (engineer): Agree with maria. Also, we should call out the rollback trigger thresholds (cpu/GPU errors, >5% error rate, 95th latency spike). Want to include the high-level rollback plan in the announcement.

kevin (infra): For rollback: suggested criteria — any sustained >3% 5xx rate over 5m OR P95 latency >2x baseline for 10m -> automatic canary pause + alert to oncall. Manual full rollback otherwise. I'll paste the short ops blurb in a sec.

jordan (comms): I can post the internal announcement once copy finalized. Preference to post immediately after successful rollout to 100% to avoid confusion. I will wait for the final blurb from kevin + confirmation that `pin_model_version` is only opt-in.

sam (eng-release-manager): deploy-bot, schedule canary for tomorrow 09:05 PDT with 15-minute canary, then 100% at ~09:20 if no issues.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: release v2.3.1 -> canary 10% at 2026-04-05T16:05:00Z (15m), automatic promote to 100% at 2026-04-05T16:20:00Z if canary checks pass. Notifications will be posted in #eng-releases.

alex (engineer): Quick note: pin_model_version defaults to false; adding example payload for docs would help. e.g., `{"pin_model_version": true, "model": "llama-3.1.2-quant"}`

maria (product): Updated draft: changed API line -> "new opt-in `pin_model_version` for /deploy to reduce drift; we recommend it for regulated/certified workloads." OK?

kevin (infra): Ops blurb: "Rollout policy: 15m canary at 10% with automated health checks (error rate, P95 latency, GPU OOM). If any check fails, canary is paused and paging starts. Manual rollback to previous infra snapshot if issues persist after 20m post-pause." Add to release notes under 'Reliability'.

sam (eng-release-manager): Thanks — this is shaping up. Jordan, want me to DM you the final text or paste here when we freeze at 17:30 PT?

jordan (comms): DM is fine. I'll craft a short internal blurb like: "Heads up: rolling deploy at 09:05 PDT; feature highlights + what to watch; reach out to #oncall for incidents." Will include link to release notes in Console. :+1:

maria (product): Sign-off from product.

alex (engineer): Sign-off from eng. I'll monitor canary.

kevin (infra): Sign-off from infra. Oncall rota is notified.

sam (eng-release-manager): All right — final freeze at 17:30 PT. If anything changes after that, we'll do an emergency rollback. Thanks all. :rocket:
